title: Certara Launches Marvin Cloud Worldwide, Bringing Professional Chemical Structure Drawing to Scientists, Researchers, Teachers and Students
summary: Certara launches Marvin Cloud worldwide — a browser-based chemical sketching platform for scientists, researchers, teachers and students. Try free for 14 days.
body_markdown:
ShareShareShare


Radnor, PA – Sept 29, 2026, Certara, Inc. (Nasdaq: CERT), a global leader in model-informed drug development, today announced the worldwide availability of Marvin Cloud, browser-based and cloud-hosted chemical sketching platform built by the Chemaxon team on the[Marvin](https://www.certara.com/marvin/) cheminformatics engine.


[Marvin Cloud](https://marvincloud.marvin.cxn.io/) gives independent and academic scientists, and students direct access to professional-grade structure drawing without the overhead of institutional software deployment. Subscriptions are now available globally, with secure payment supported worldwide and every new account starting with a 14-day free trial.


*“Supporting scientific breakthroughs in chemistry is core to who we are, and for decades that’s meant putting professional-grade chemistry tools within reach of academic and research budgets, powering countless breakthroughs at the bench and in the classroom. Marvin Cloud carries that tradition forward for today’s researchers, giving individuals the same trusted Marvin our enterprise customers have been deploying with success for many years now,”* said Adrian Stevens, Head of Product, Chemaxon.


Marvin Cloud brings the core Marvin capabilities to the cloud, including hotkey-driven workflows, publication-ready output, advanced polymer and Markush/R-group drawing, enumeration, precise stereochemistry handling and precise chemical property calculations. The platform is under active development, with new capabilities added on an ongoing basis.


The platform is set up as an individual subscription, with flexible pricing designed to meet the budgets of academic and independent researchers, teachers and students. Academic and not-for-profit institutions looking for a broader deployment can still take advantage of the[Chemaxon Academic Discount](https://www.certara.com/chemaxon-academic-discount) .


## About Certara


Certara transforms drug discovery and development for good, helping scientists and clinical teams generate regulatory-grade evidence faster. Its solutions combine biosimulation, clinical intelligence, and regulatory science, and are embedded in the workflows of drug developers worldwide. Certara clients include more than 2,600 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and global regulatory agencies. Learn more at certara.com.
